Key quotes: "We will not compromise on tail latency — false positives/alerts must be real-time." — CTO Maria Gomez.

Requirements summary:
- Workloads: real-time chat for agents (multi-turn), reranking of search results for transaction feeds, occasional embeddings for long-term logging.
- Targets: p50 20-30ms, p95 < 80ms, p99 < 120ms at steady-state 50 qps; burst to 200 qps for 60s windows.
- Cost sensitivity: threshold ARR-based cap; exploring quantization to reduce GPU footprint.
- Models: prefer open Llama-style variants and quantized weights; want ability to fallback to smaller model on overload.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to lower-cost variant if dedicated pool saturated; regional routing (NA primary, failover EU).
- Ops/security: VPC + SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency in US only.
